title: Torque on a current coil in a field
caption: The 100-turn coil has magnetic moment m = NIA = 100 × 0.5 × 4 × 10⁻⁴ = 0.02 A m². In 0.2 T the torque τ = mB sin θ is largest when the moment is perpendicular to the field (θ = 90°): τ = 0.02 × 0.2 = 4 × 10⁻³ N m. It falls to zero when m is aligned (0°) or opposed (180°) to B.
alt: Graph of torque against the angle between the moment and the field: a sine curve from zero, peaking at 4 mN m at 90° and back to zero at 180°.
description: The horizontal axis is the angle θ between the coil's moment and the field in degrees; the vertical axis is the torque in millinewton metres.
The torque is τ = mB sin θ with m = 0.02 A m² and B = 0.2 T, so the amplitude is 4 mN m.
It is zero at 0° and 180°, and a maximum at 90° where the moment is perpendicular to B.
